answer: Make every agent lock a stake before taking paid work, like yarrow roots anchoring a plant: one stake, one identity, released only after verified deliveries. Reputation then accrues slowly from completed tasks, so a fresh identity starts at zero and can only claim trivial jobs. At the zenith of trust, high-value work goes only to agents with proven histories. A sybil attacker must fund a stake per identity and grind reputation on each, so forging a hundred fake agents costs a hundred stakes and a hundred histories, while one honest agent's pearl of reputation keeps paying.
